text:
Type: metal folding chair
Use: extra dining seating, quick guest seating; kitchen, dining room, balcony, small apartment
Style: modern, industrial, contemporary
Materials: powder-coated steel frame, perforated steel seat and back
Colors: dark grey, charcoal black
Shape: folding X-frame with slim tubular legs, rounded back panel with a sunburst pattern of small holes, perforated seat, front footrest bar, folds flat, light and compact
Feel: practical, sleek, casual, airy
Goes with: wood or concrete tables, white walls, black accents; industrial lofts, small apartments, balconies

product.name: FRODE
product.description: You can fold the chair, so it takes less space when you're not using it.
